content.value_statement: Node.js teams need reliable telemetry without rebuilding their observability stack. This skill guides Azure Monitor OpenTelemetry setup for traces, metrics, logs, exporters, sampling, and shutdown.
actual_capabilities: Shows package installation choices for Azure Monitor distro, exporters, and custom log ingestion.
Explains useAzureMonitor initialization order for Node.js auto-instrumentation.
Provides TypeScript examples for traces, metrics, logs, sampling, and span processors.
Covers manual trace, metric, and log exporter setup with OpenTelemetry SDK providers.
Describes ESM loader usage, offline storage options, and graceful shutdown.
limitations: Does not create Azure resources or configure portal settings.
Does not validate connection strings, data collection rules, or endpoint permissions.
Assumes users understand TypeScript, Node.js startup order, and Azure authentication.
Examples may need package version updates for future Azure SDK releases.

use_cases.title: Add Service Telemetry
use_cases.description: Instrument an Express or Node.js TypeScript service with traces, metrics, and logs.

use_cases.title: Standardize Azure Observability
use_cases.description: Document consistent Azure Monitor setup steps for multiple application teams.

use_cases.title: Tune Production Signals
use_cases.description: Plan sampling, offline storage, custom dimensions, and graceful telemetry shutdown.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up Basic Telemetry
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new service
prompt_templates.prompt: Add Azure Monitor to a Node.js TypeScript service. Include required packages, environment variables, and initialization order.

prompt_templates.title: Add Custom Signals
prompt_templates.prompt: Extend my service with custom traces and metrics. Use OpenTelemetry names that fit HTTP request and background job workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Configure Manual Exporters
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a manual exporter setup for traces, metrics, and logs. Explain provider setup, processors, and shutdown behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Review Production Design
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this production telemetry architecture. Recommend sampling, offline storage, exporter choices, and operational checks for an Azure Monitor deployment.

output_examples.input: Configure Azure Monitor for an Express TypeScript service.
output: Use the Azure Monitor OpenTelemetry distro for automatic instrumentation.
Set the connection string through a managed environment variable.
Initialize monitoring before importing Express or route modules.

output_examples.input: Review my telemetry setup for production readiness.
output: Check sampling against expected request volume.
Enable graceful shutdown so telemetry flushes before process exit.
Review failed log handling before writing payloads to application logs.

output_examples.input: Plan custom logs ingestion for Azure Monitor.
output: Use a data collection endpoint and data collection rule identifier.
Validate stream names and table mappings before production rollout.

best_practices: Initialize Azure Monitor before importing instrumented libraries.
Keep connection strings in environment variables or managed secrets.
Tune sampling and shutdown behavior before high-volume production rollout.
anti_patterns: Hardcoding connection strings directly in source files.
Enabling every instrumentation option without checking telemetry volume.
Logging full failed payloads when records may contain personal data.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps add Azure Monitor OpenTelemetry instrumentation to Node.js and TypeScript services.

faq.question: Does it require Application Insights?
faq.answer: It uses Azure Monitor and Application Insights connection strings for telemetry export.

faq.question: Can it help with ESM projects?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes Node.js ESM loader guidance for the Azure Monitor OpenTelemetry package.

faq.question: Does it create Azure resources?
faq.answer: No. It explains application instrumentation, not Azure resource creation.

faq.question: Can I use custom exporters?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers trace, metric, and log exporters for manual OpenTelemetry setups.

faq.question: What should I prepare before using it?
faq.answer: Prepare a connection string, package manager access, and the Node.js service entry point.
